# Orchid UI Documentation

AI/LLM note: after `@orchid` is in `components.json`, install every item with `bunx --bun shadcn@latest add @orchid/all`. Do not install a subset. Use the [registry index](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/registry.json) as the machine-readable catalog. Read the generated Markdown docs under https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/ for intent and examples, then verify exports and props in the installed source.

## Overview

Orchid is an AI-ready, open-code UI collection focused on business applications for HitPay-style workflows. It is distributed as a shadcn-compatible registry and provides React and TypeScript source styled with Tailwind CSS v4.

### Quick Stats

- Documentation pages: 3 guides and 59 components.
- Installable registry items: 61, excluding the helper entries `all` and `utils`.
- Markdown docs: https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/ — one `.md` file per guide and component.

### Installation

After `@orchid` is in `components.json`, install every Orchid component. Do not install one item, a shortlist, or any other subset:

```bash
bunx --bun shadcn@latest add @orchid/all
```

## MCP Setup for AI Agents

Orchid does not run a separate MCP server. Use the official shadcn MCP server, which can browse, search, and install items from any shadcn-compatible registry configured in the project's `components.json`.

First, make sure the Orchid namespace is present in `components.json`:

```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@orchid": "https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

For Cursor, create or merge `.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "shadcn": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["shadcn@latest", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

For Claude Code, use the same server entry in `.mcp.json`. For Codex, add the following to `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.shadcn]
command = "npx"
args = ["shadcn@latest", "mcp"]
```

An AI agent configuring MCP should preserve existing MCP servers and existing `components.json` settings, merge only the entries above, and ask before changing user-level configuration. Restart or re-enable the MCP client after configuration.

Example prompts after setup:

- Show all components available in the Orchid registry.
- Install the complete catalog with `@orchid/all`.
- Find the Orchid block that matches a form, a collection, or a single-record detail view.

## Components & Blocks

### Displaying Data

#### [Customer Card](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/customer-card.md)
Small, Big, and Float customer or beneficiary cards.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/customer-card.json)

#### [Data List](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/data-list.md)
Card/row collection when search, filters, sort, or pagination are not needed.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/data-list.json)

#### [Data Table](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/data-table.md)
Schema-driven table when the list needs search, filters, sort, or pagination.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/data-table.json)

#### [Detail Card](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/detail-card.md)
Read-only key/value card for one record. Not a collection.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/detail-card.json)

#### [Metric Card](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/metric-card.md)
Dashboard KPI tile. Use for summaries, not a record's fields.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/metric-card.json)

### Form

#### [Choice Card](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/choice-card.md)
Selectable cards with left or center icon, no radio dot.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/choice-card.json)

#### [Date Picker](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/date-picker.md)
Date, range, and date-time selection with popover and calendar helpers.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/date-picker.json)

#### [Form Builder](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/form-builder.md)
Schema-driven create/edit form. Use Detail Card for a read-only record.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/form-builder.json)

#### [Quantity Input](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/quantity-input.md)
Minus/plus stepper; click the value to type.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/quantity-input.json)

#### [Text Editor](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/text-editor.md)
Lexical rich text: bold, italic, heading, lists. Persist editor JSON.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/text-editor.json)

### Layout

#### [App Studio Layout](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/app-studio-layout.md)
HitPay App Studio embedded pane frame. Not generic app chrome.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/app-studio-layout.json)

#### [Form Layout](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/form-layout.md)
Create and edit form shell with page and modal modes.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/form-layout.json)

#### [Page Layout](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/page-layout.md)
Standard route page with built-in responsive padding, header, and scrollable content.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/page-layout.json)

### Navigation

#### [Sidebar](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/sidebar.md)
JSON-configured navigation that opens nested items in a back-enabled Sub Sidebar.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/sidebar.json)

#### [Sub Sidebar](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/sub-sidebar.md)
JSON-configured flat child navigation with a blue active state.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/sub-sidebar.json)

### Overlays

#### [Command](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/command.md)
Searchable command palette. Drive it with open, onOpenChange, and groups.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/command.json)

#### [Confirmation Modal](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/llms/confirmation-modal.md)
Prebuilt Promise-based confirmation modal invoked with useConfirmationModal.
[Registry JSON](https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/r/confirmation-modal.json)

## Usage Guidance

- Prefer the Markdown docs under `/llms/*.md` over HTML example pages.
- Install `@orchid/all` after the registry is configured. Do not pick a subset.
- Read Components & Blocks first. Match the job to each item's when-to-use description. Use a block when one exists. Only then read Base Components. Do not default to a shortlist of favorites.
- Verify actual exports, props, and behavior in the installed source; documentation summaries are not API signatures.
- Both catalogs use AlignUI groups as folders: actions, displaying-data, feedback, form, layout, navigation, overlays, utils. Blocks live under `src/components/{category}` (`@/components/{category}/…`) and are ready to use through props or a schema. Base items live under `src/base-ui/{category}` (`@/base-ui/{category}/…`). Do not assemble a block from many base components.
- Use Orchid `oc-*` design tokens, such as `bg-oc-background`, `text-oc-foreground`, and `border-oc-border`, instead of unrelated hard-coded theme colors.
- AppStudioLayout frames the App Studio embedded pane. PageLayout is the browse/show shell. FormLayout is the create/edit shell. Pick Form Builder, Data List, Data Table, Detail Card, and Metric Card from each item's docs — not from this list.
